method: Native-size in-app browser composition at landscape33.2s(1920x1080) and portrait22.2s(1080x1920) compared visually with corrected2x compositor stills and decoded short H.264 diagnostic frames. Artist/title/footer spacing and opacity, original album image and sleeve transform, bilingual word geometry, paired highlight states and ribbon placement were inspected.
fixes: Explicit static-text adapter preserves SVG letter-spacing and opacity omitted by the native SVG decoder.
Original image is drawn at the transform parsed from the frozen shared scene.
Each encoder write callback completes before the next native canvas buffer access.
Explicit BT.709 frame parameters survive encoder color metadata.
limits: Visual adoption of an export implementation for the unchanged approved scene; not a new listening attestation or an assertion of browser pixel equality. The full outputs still require independent encoded-file verification.
